title: First-Hour SDK Onboarding — interactive storyboard and progressive reveal assets
creator: Aisha Fernandez
description: Deliver a set of lightweight, developer-facing assets to cover the first 60 minutes of SDK usage: 1) interactive storyboard (7 frames) that progressively reveals the happy path from API key creation to a streaming response with a tool call, 2) a set of 6 static screenshots optimized for docs (light & dark variants), 3) Lottie-friendly micro-animations for streaming and KV cache visuals, and 4) an assets pack and cut-sheets for engineering to embed in the docs site and SDK quickstart. Focus: clarity for developers who open the page and want runnable examples in under 10 minutes; ensure auth/key rotation, minimal error states, and tool-calling examples are covered. Accessibility: meeting AA contrast and providing alt text for all images. Deliverables will be a Figma file with annotated frames, exported PNGs/SVGs, Lottie JSONs (2), and a short implementation notes doc for the engineering teammate.
comments: 2026-03-10 — Kickoff: scoped wireframes and agreed 7 storyboard frames. PM requested explicit key rotation step and non-blocking fallback for streaming timeouts.
2026-03-11 — Initial comps uploaded to Figma. Engineering flagged constraints around live streaming thumbnails and requested Lottie vs GIF decision; Lottie preferred for size and accessibility.

2026-03-12 — Design review: reduced copy length on code snippets, added step labels (Step 0: Create API Key; Step 1: Install SDK; Step 2: Make a call; Step 3: Stream & Toolcall; Step 4: Rotate credentials; Step 5: Inspect console and metrics).
2026-03-13 — Accessibility pass: color contrast adjusted (buttons from #1A73E8 to #125fd3), alt text drafts added to each frame. QA checklist attached to Figma.
2026-03-14 — Engineering review: confirmed docs site supports segmented JSON + streaming demo sandbox; requested one additional screenshot showing failed tool call fallback to text-only response.
2026-03-15 — PM sign-off on narrative; follow-up TODOs: export assets, create cut-sheets, and handoff notes. Assigned implementation PR to ENG-22908.
